newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weak as dollar demand up.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weak as dollar demand up.

text.p: Bangladesh taka closed easier at 42.5390/42.5490 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous 42.5380/42.5480, dealers said.

The taka was quoted at 42.5350/42.580 in early trading but slipped later on higher demand for dollars. "The taka lost eventually as demand for dollar picked up mostly for import payments," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
The interbank call money rates ended unchanged at 4.0 percent to 4.75 percent, dealers said.
